note: VCF Automation has no machine-readable API specification published in the
vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0) and Broadcom offers no downloadable
OpenAPI document for these operations, so the contract was derived by reading the
human-readable xAPIs reference pages listed below. One entry per page fetched.
`includedInContract` records whether the operation that page documents was carried
into docs/contract.json or deliberately left out.
referenceTitle: VCF Automation OpenAPI | Provider Infrastructure APIs

pages.documents: Provider Infrastructure APIs overview: authentication (JWT in Authorization header), API versioning via the Accept header (application/json;version=9.1.0), CRUD status-code conventions, asynchronous operations returning HTTP 202 with an empty body and the tracking task URI in the Location header, and the full API category index.
Operation index. Used to enumerate the Named Credential operations and to confirm that no Task category or /tasks operation is documented in this API.
Named Credential category listing: the ten operations under /namedCredentials, including the note that associated vCenter sessions are terminated on delete.

GET /cloudapi/1.0.0/namedCredentials - Query Named Credentials. Query parameters filter (FIQL), sortAsc, sortDesc, page (required, default 1, min 1), pageSize (required, default 25, min 0, max 128); 200 response page wrapper and NamedCredential item fields.
POST /cloudapi/1.0.0/namedCredentials - Create Named Credential. Request body fields name, username, password (required) and entity (optional); 201 response returning the NamedCredential.
GET /cloudapi/1.0.0/namedCredentials/{id} - Get Named Credential. Path parameter id; 200 response with the full NamedCredential schema (id, name, org, entity, username, password, behavior).
PUT /cloudapi/1.0.0/namedCredentials/{id} - Update Named Credential. All request body fields (name, entity, username, password) optional; 200 response returning the NamedCredential.

DELETE /cloudapi/1.0.0/namedCredentials/{id} - Delete Named Credential. 202 Accepted with no response body and the tracking task URI in the Location header; documented side effect that the associated vCenter sessions will be terminated.

GET /cloudapi/1.0.0/namedCredentials/{namedCredentialId}/accessControls - Query Named Credential Access Control Grants. Paged response of AccessControlGrant (id, tenant, grantType, objectId, accessLevelId).
pages.exclusionReason: Read during derivation but out of scope for the rotation workflow; the bundled mock does not serve it.

pages.documents: Virtual Center category listing: the operations under /virtualCenters, used to locate the get and update operations for a single vCenter registration.

GET /cloudapi/1.0.0/virtualCenters/{vcUrn} - Get Virtual Center. 200 response with the VCenterServer schema including the connection-state fields isConnected, listenerState and clusterHealthStatus; 400 and 404 error responses.

PUT /cloudapi/1.0.0/virtualCenters/{vcUrn} - Update Virtual Center. Request body VCenterServer with name, url and username required and the remaining fields optional; 202 Accepted, no body, tracking task URI in the Location header.
Test Connection category listing: the single operation POST /cloudapi/1.0.0/testConnection.

POST /cloudapi/1.0.0/testConnection - Test a connection. Request body host and port required; secure (default true), timeout (default 10, 1-120), hostnameVerificationAlgorithm, additionalCAIssuers, proxyConnection and preConfiguredProxy optional. 200 response with targetProbe and proxyProbe.
Audit Trail category listing: the single operation GET /cloudapi/1.0.0/auditTrail.

GET /cloudapi/1.0.0/auditTrail - Query Audit Trail. Query parameters filter (FIQL), sortAsc, sortDesc, page (required, default 1), pageSize (required, default 25, max 128); paged response of AuditTrailEvent including taskId, eventEntity, eventType, eventStatus and timestamp.
Sessions category listing: the /cloudapi/1.0.0/sessions family (list, login, logout, current session, current rights, accessible locations, provider login).
pages.exclusionReason: These are API login sessions for the calling user, not the vCenter sessions referenced by the delete hazard, so they are not part of the rotation workflow.
